faq_heading: Homes near Hazelgrove Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Hazelgrove Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Hazelgrove Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Hazelgrove Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Hazelgrove Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Clayton Heights Secondary (0.6 km west), Katzie Elementary (0.7 km east) and Regent Road Elementary (1.1 km north-west).

Hazelgrove Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 7057 - 191 Street. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Hazelgrove Elementary in the listing.
How the Hazelgrove Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Hazelgrove Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Hazelgrove Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Hazelgrove Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 4 secondary, 2 other, 1 middle; 2 independent). The closest is Clayton Heights Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Martha Currie Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Katzie Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Salish Secondary (1.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Katzie Elementary (0.7 km east), Regent Road Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Maddaugh Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Hillcrest Elementary (1.5 km south-west), Adams Road Elementary (1.8 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Katzie Elementary, 0.7 km east of Hazelgrove Elementary.
